## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5bae87cb7e9a2aaa61c53b712bd484a77ce3a45c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json + none

Inputs read: card #31925 (body and its three comments, the claim 6765951610 included), PR #32189 (body, file list, net diff against `main`), and the check-runs on this head. The cited code was read on `origin/main` (`e1146e806`); none of the cited files changed between the merge base `7e8b31ce5` and that tip. The diff raises no row in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (the i18n ceiling stays 6333), so there is no implementing file in the diff. `.changeset/skills-i18n-action-preflight.md` is the remainder, the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Check-runs on the head: all completed, none failed. 30 concluded `success` (Lint & Repo Gates, Build Core, Test Core and its shards, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard among them); the other 18 concluded `skipped` (UI, docs, dogfood-shard and opt-in families the path filter does not select).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: unchanged — right.** The diff touches no schema, lint or reader. `preflight.fields` is already accepted by `actionTranslationSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` L405), already judged by `checkActionPreflightFields` (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` L3065) and already read by `actionPreflight` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` L788). No bundle that parsed before is refused after, and none refused before parses after.
- **Public surface: published skill prose only — right.** `@objectstack/skills` ships two more sentences in `SKILL.md` and one eval fixture. No export, key or CLI behaviour moves; `references/_index.md` stays true because `ActionPreflightTranslationSchema` is module-local (translation.zod.ts L316–L321).
- **Token ratchet: no row change — right.** The file grows inside its existing ceiling, and `Lint & Repo Gates` is green on the head.
- **Governed path: `skills/**` — right.** The rules face applies, and Tier H approval stays whole-PR.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` matches what the diff publishes: prose teaching an existing key, the level the sibling skills changesets on `main` carry (`30549-skills-action-param-widget.md`, for one). `Check Changeset` is green.

Clause-②: no — correct on the PR body and on the changeset. Nothing is widened or narrowed; `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct for the same reason.

### ③ Boundary flags

No `open_questions` entry is raised. The dev's flags, each answered:

- **`preflight.title` is refused at parse, not by the lint (a precision on the card).** Confirmed. The node is a `strictObject` whose only key is `fields`, with a `title` guidance line (translation.zod.ts L321–L330), and `defineTranslationBundle` parses `TranslationBundleSchema` (L2594–L2596). `checkActionPreflightFields` judges `fields` paths only. Teaching the `title` refusal in the key row and only the path rule in the lint paragraph is the correct split; the card's "refusal list" placement would have taught a lint finding that does not exist.
- **Surface widened to `evals/*.json`.** In surface: the claim (6765951610) names `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/*.json` for one `preflight.fields` case, and the diff adds exactly one.
- **"Three more shapes" omits `submitText` and `cancelText` (pre-existing, left out).** Confirmed real: `checkActionEntry` also calls `checkActionSubmitText` and `checkActionCancelText` (L2661–L2662), both `translation-target-unknown`. It predates this diff and is not about `preflight`; this diff does not change its truth value. Answered as nit N2 below, owed a follow-up card.
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` does not point at the bundle key.** Outside this card's surface and not a false sentence. No action here.
- **`content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx` measured.** The card asked for the measurement; the PR body answers it, and the file is not in the diff. Nothing to judge.
- **Model-tier waiver for the card thread.** Not this record's to rule on. This record is the contract review of record, served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

Nothing is escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`** — holds. Each taught sentence against `main`:

| Sentence | Verdict | Code read |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `preflight.fields.{path}` is a key under `_actions.{action_name}` | true | translation.zod.ts L401–L406 |
| only under an action that declares `preflight` | true | lint L3083–L3085 (the "declares no `preflight`" variant, severity `error`); `resolveActionPreflight` returns the spec untouched (`i18n-resolver.ts` L979–L985); `useObjectLabel.ts` L796 |
| keyed by a field's literal `path` in its `preflight.fields[]` | true | translation.zod.ts L309–L312; `i18n-walk.ts` L839 pushes `field.path` as one segment; `useObjectLabel.ts` L781–L782 |
| its value a plain string, as under `resultDialog.fields` | true | both are `z.record(z.string(), z.string())` (L296, L328) |
| `defineTranslationBundle` refuses any other key under `preflight`, a `title` included | true | strict object L321–L330; L2594–L2596 |
| the same keys hold under `globalActions.{action_name}` (existing tail, now covering the new key) | true | one factory serves both addresses (L342, L1213); lint and walker run the same check on global actions (`i18n-walk.ts` L1622) |
| an undeclared `preflight.fields` path is `translation-target-unknown`, an error | true | lint L3076–L3094, `TRANSLATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN_SEVERITY = 'error'` (L320) |
| an action with no `preflight` declares none | true | lint L3070–L3074: `declared` is empty, so every key is a finding |
| "Three more shapes" still counts three | true as counted | the preflight path joins the `resultDialog.fields` item |

Attempts to break it, none of which landed:
- A `preflight` that declares no `fields`: every bundle path under it is the error (third message variant, L3090–L3092), which "a path it does not declare" covers.
- An action that cannot carry `preflight` at all (no `params`, or `execution: 'aggregate'`): `ActionSchema` refuses the `preflight` itself (`action.zod.ts` L2484–L2500), so the bundle rule never meets a contradicting case.
- Coverage and extract: `pushActionPreflight` emits one entry per declared field for object and global actions, so the skill's existing "every surface the extractor walks" sentence stays true without an edit.
- A per-locale inline `label` map on a preflight field: the bundle value is still a string, and the reader keeps the authored map when the bundle has none. No taught sentence says otherwise.

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`** — holds. Case 10 matches the nine existing cases' shape (`id`, `prompt`, `expected_output`, `files`, `assertions`). The scenario is one `main` allows: `preflight` lives on an action with `params`, so "opens its param dialog" is right. Every sentence of `expected_output` is true on `main` (literal-path keys, string values, strict node, `translation-target-unknown` for an undeclared path). Every `must_contain` string occurs in `expected_output`, and neither `must_not_contain` string does. The case is answerable from the taught row alone, and it fails the two wrong answers the card names: an invented `title`, and the dotted path split into nested objects.

Findings:

- **N1 (nit) — `must_not_contain: "title:"` is a broad substring.** A correct answer that warns against the key in code form (`preflight: { title: … }` is refused) would trip it. It has no effect on the contract or on what the skill teaches; left as an accepted deviation, to tighten when the eval file is next touched.
- **N2 (nit, follow-up card) — the "Three more shapes under an action entry" sentence is incomplete, and was before this diff.** `submitText` under an action with no `params` and `cancelText` under an action with neither `confirmText` nor `params` are the same error, and the key row does not name `cancelText` at all. This diff neither introduces nor worsens it. It is owed its own `domain:skills` card, not a change on this head.

No must-fix and no should-fix. Nits alone end the round.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-wv55j6`
Reviewed-by: `session_01J8VVAmAzSRKZHAn7T8sArV`

**VERDICT: PASS**
